notes: Merian plate dated 1642 (first edition of Topographia Helvetiae) rather than the 1654 edition in #6’s title; ZB Zürich dates its copy ‘after 1638’. Münster’s 1550 woodcut (#4) is a usable alternative for P1 if an earlier view is wanted. #13 is cataloged 1835–61; Loppé was born in 1825 and the Pont du Mont-Blanc (1862) is absent, hence 1850s. #2 Nyon, #7 Vevey, #15–19 Montreux/Ouchy are other towns on the lake.
